name: Warm Neutral
use: A personal house palette. Warm-neutral field, charcoal ink, single coral accent. Built on 60-30-10. Distinct from the Corporate Blue identity — do not mix the two in one deliverable.
discipline: Warm neutral field carries roughly 60% of the surface; charcoal ink plus one supporting tint carries 30%; coral appears on about 10% and never more. Low contrast between the neutrals, high contrast between ink and field. No shadows, no coloured backgrounds beyond the neutral family.
never: coral #CC785C as text on the cream field (2.92:1 — fails at every size)
white text on a coral fill (3.28:1 — use charcoal #1F1E1D at 5.08:1)
sage mist #B3CBC1 or rule #D4D0C9 as text on any neutral (1.5:1 and 1.4:1)
more than one accent colour on a page
mixing this palette with the Corporate Blue identity
